570: ## Round 2 — Landau (Final Response)
  571: 
  572: ### Re: Transit Q1 (Susceptibility matrix eigenvalues)
  573: 
  574: Transit asks for the eigenvalues of the 3x3 susceptibility matrix chi_{ab}^{-1} to determine the physical mu_eff. I can construct this from the known BCS parameters.
  575: 
  576: The Landau-Khalatnikov relaxation for a multi-component order parameter (Paper 09, generalized to multi-band BCS, Paper 15) gives the relaxation eigenmodes as eigenvalues of chi_{ab}^{-1} * tau_0^{-1}, where:
  577: 
  578:     chi_{ab} = psi_a * delta_{ab} / Delta_a + V_cross_{ab}^{-1}           (L4.1)
  579: 
  580: The diagonal elements are the intra-branch susceptibilities (proportional to the density of states psi_a / Delta_a), and the off-diagonal elements come from the inter-branch Josephson coupling V_cross.
